channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Charles Barkley | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Charles Barkley from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kevin Johnson on Charles Barkley
item.description:
“So Charles and I had a bet one time. I ain’t gonna tell you what the bet was, but if I won, he had to go to church with me,”

Kevin Johnson on Charles Barkley, Feb 4, 2026. Source: Basketball Network.

item.title: Richard Jefferson on Charles Barkley, Karl Malone
item.description:
“The reason why I would pick Karl Malone over Charles is because of the level of professionalism that Karl Malone always approached,”

Richard Jefferson on Charles Barkley, Karl Malone, Aug 4, 2025. Source: Awful Announcing.

item.title: Nickeil Alexander-Walker on Charles Barkley
item.description:
Nickeil Alexander-Walker on Charles Barkley's comments about the pronunciation of his name:

“I thought like in media they give them dictionaries how they have that pronunciation thing? Maybe he's not reading it, I don't know.”

Nickeil Alexander-Walker on Charles Barkley, May 26, 2025. Source: reddit.

item.title: Tim Kawakami on Charles Barkley
item.description:
Tim Kawakami on ESPN:

“My understanding, though, is also this is a little clearing the decks. Like, you know, you would have thought Woj leaving would have cleared a lot of money—which certainly did—but thatthey are clearing the decks for a run at Charles Barkley next yearwhen the TNT is over. I don’t know that they’re going to get Barkley, but I think they’re just clearing it out, saying, ‘We’re going to redo what we do as we can.’”

Tim Kawakami on Charles Barkley, Oct 25, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Charles Barkley
item.description:
“That’s me speaking from a loyalty situation. That’s real shit what he did because I know the numbers that are being thrown at Barkley. I know the conversation that’s being had about Barkley. Those Stephen A. numbers are official. All those numbers are real…It’s loyalty.”

Carmelo Anthony on Charles Barkley, Aug 21, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Charles Barkley
item.description:
Anthony shared his high praises for Barkley on 7 PM in Brooklyn, a Wave Sports + Entertainment Original.

“With Barkley it comes down to ‘This is home, I don’t want to leave this. We done built this. I built my whole life off this s–t.’ The money is enticing because they gotta throw the money out there and rightfully so, he deserves the numbers that’s out there but you can’t leave,”

Carmelo Anthony on Charles Barkley, Aug 21, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: LeBron James on Michael Jordan, Charles Barkley
item.description:
“They say Michael never talked to any of his opponents, but I’m also smart enough to know that him and Charles (Barkley) had a lot of conversations during the ’93 finals and also played golf against each other. “So I don’t want to lose those moments (with Curry).”

LeBron James on Michael Jordan, Charles Barkley, Jul 18, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Charles Barkley
item.description:
Kendrick Perkins on Charles Barkley's comments:

“I don't mind to be a punching bag, I don't mind that. But don't call me no damn roach, bro. I ain't on that. Don't call me no roach, bro. Come on, dog. That's the worst of the worst. From another black man to another black man, you can't never call nobody no roach. You might as well spit in my face. That was raw. We kill roaches in black neighborhoods. Roaches everywhere. Come on, man. As a black man to another black man, you can't never call nobody no roach. You might as well spit in my face.”

Kendrick Perkins on Charles Barkley, Jun 13, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Charles Barkley
item.description:
Ben Golliver:Timberwolves’ Rudy Gobert on TNT’s Charles Barkley suggesting he should be benched in Game 7 win over Nuggets:

“I don’t watch these guys. … I’m glad coach didn’t listen to his advice.”

Rudy Gobert on Charles Barkley, May 20, 2024. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Michael Jordan, Charles Barkley
item.description:
Shaquille O'Neal:

“If Paxson doesn't hit that shot, Michael Jordan doesn't have six rings, and Charles Barkley has one. I'm glad Paxson hit that shot. I would hate to see Charles with a ring. You couldn't tell him nothing.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Michael Jordan, Charles Barkley, May 6, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Reggie Miller on Michael Jordan, Isiah Thomas, Charles Barkley, Joe Dumars, Patrick Ewing, Larry Bird, Robert Parish
item.description:
Miller was a five-time All-Star, with his first All-Star selection coming in 1990 in Miami in just his third NBA season.

“I remember in 1990 walking into the locker room for the first time, and there's Larry (Bird) and there's Isiah (Thomas) and there was Jordan and there was Joe Dumars and there was Robert Parish, there was Charles (Barkley), Patrick (Ewing),”

Reggie Miller on Michael Jordan, Isiah Thomas, Charles Barkley, Joe Dumars, Patrick Ewing, Larry Bird, Robert Parish, Feb 16, 2024. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Charles Barkley
item.description:
“I used to hate Charles. We were getting ready to get into a fight, and before I could get to the locker room and put my clothes on to go down to the locker room and see him, I get a call from his mother… who said ‘don’t you hit my boy’ and I was like ‘who is this?’”

Shaquille O'Neal on Charles Barkley, Jun 5, 2023. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Charles Barkley
item.description:
Durant told Yahoo Sports.

“I don’t need no credit from y’all, no credit from [Barkley], no credit from Shaq. Y’all don’t ever have to watch me play ever again, don’t talk about me if you don’t [rock] with me. I’m not gonna stop doing what I do. Everybody has their opinions, man. It’s not gonna stop me and how I approach the game. “As far as leading a team, I don’t need to coach no team. Whatever happens, we do it together. [Monty’s] the leader, he’s the coach. The GM puts the team together. I’m supposed to go out and hoop. That’s my job.”

Kevin Durant on Charles Barkley, Mar 2, 2023. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Ja Morant on Charles Barkley
item.description:
Ja Morant on Charles Barkley:

“Nobody can tell me what I do and don't besides my teammates. Those guys said it. An outsider who never been in our locker room or played a game with us said I don't make my teammates better. But our guys say it all the time. There ya go. Kneepads.”

Ja Morant on Charles Barkley, Nov 18, 2022. Source: Twitter @DrewHill_DM.

item.title: Monty McCutchen on Charles Barkley
item.description:
“It’s hard to get windup and impact when all 10 players are playing in the paint like Charles Barkley did,”

Monty McCutchen on Charles Barkley, May 14, 2022. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Charles Oakley on Charles Barkley
item.description:
“So I know he wants to come to the cookout and play 18 holes with us. But we’re not inviting him no more. He’s out. You act up, you go stand in the corner with one leg in the air .... That’s Charles, in the corner of the playground by himself. You can see him, because he’s kind of big.”

Charles Oakley on Charles Barkley, Feb 3, 2022. Source: Toronto Star.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Steve Nash, Charles Barkley, Reggie Miller
item.description:
“It’s the nature of the ball not bouncing your way here or there, injuries, breaks, stuff like that. But perennially, a guy like CP, you want him on your team no matter what. He’s made every team he has been on competitive and better than they would be otherwise. However you calculate that or quantify that, it’s winning. You want to have the championships. “But nobody questions his ability to impact the game and to win at the highest level. The championship will probably be nice for him, but that’s not going to define him. You got guys like Charles Barkley, Steve Nash, Reggie Miller, a who’s who of Hall of Famers who haven’t won a championship. You understand how hard it is.”

Stephen Curry on Steve Nash, Charles Barkley, Reggie Miller, Jan 10, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Charles Barkley
item.description:
“Charles is gonna be here forever. We need him, and he needs us. I’m convinced that if I’m retired and I don’t do nothing, I will falter away. This is what we do and what we live for. It’s what we’ve been doing, and we need each other. “We keep each other going. Look, I’ve been here 11 years. I’ve heard that spiel before, but he’s gonna be here till the wheels fall off.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Charles Barkley, Nov 13, 2021. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Charles Barkley
item.description:
“Charles is gonna be here forever. We need him, and he needs us. I’m convinced that if I’m retired and I don’t do nothing, I will falter away. This is what we do and what we live for. It’s what we’ve been doing, and we need each other.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Charles Barkley, Nov 12, 2021. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Charles Barkley
item.description:
“After Davis returned in Game 6, Barkley questioned why the Lakers’ medical staff allowed Davis to play.“I don’t have to prove nothing to anyone,”

Anthony Davis on Charles Barkley, Jun 4, 2021. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Steve Kerr on LeBron James, Charles Barkley
item.description:
He’s 17 years in, running up the score on a foe who should have caught him by now.

“Charles Barkley always says ‘Father Time is undefeated’ but LeBron is putting up a hell of a fight right now,”

Steve Kerr on LeBron James, Charles Barkley, Oct 4, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Charles Barkley
item.description:
Barkley found some agreement from his co-hosts, including Shaquille O’Neal:

“I have to agree with Charles, this one is sort of lumped in,”

Shaquille O'Neal on Charles Barkley, Sep 25, 2020. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Charles Barkley
item.description:
“AndI was like, 'Hello?' and she's like, 'This is Charles' mom and your mom's on the phone too.'”

Shaquille O'Neal on Charles Barkley, Sep 18, 2020. Source: People.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Charles Barkley
item.description:
“I was like, 'Yes ma'am, how are you?' She said, 'Y'all need to stop. I already talked to Charles. He's gonna meet you in the hallway. Y'all need to stop and hug. Y'all are two of the greatest players in the world, we don't want y'all fighting in front of the kids, y'all stop that.'”

Shaquille O'Neal on Charles Barkley, Sep 18, 2020. Source: People.

item.title: Adam Silver on Charles Barkley
item.description:
“And I'd only say, Charles, that this has been the back-and-forth with our teams. There's so much here that's not fair, and we're choosing among multiple bad alternatives given the (coronavirus) pandemic we're dealing with. ... I think, ultimately, to the extent a team has a healthy roster and those players are able to come back, they are eligible to play.”

Adam Silver on Charles Barkley, Jun 5, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Karl Malone on Charles Barkley, Chris Webber, Derrick Coleman
item.description:
Of his many claims, many of which were spot on, Malone listed three fellow power forwards who had more God-given ability than he did, but didn’t quite reach the same level of play.

“I’m going to tell you three guys that had more talent than Karl Malone -- Chris Webber, Derrick Coleman and Charles Barkley,”

Karl Malone on Charles Barkley, Chris Webber, Derrick Coleman, May 23, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Draymond Green on Charles Barkley
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Draymond Green on the recent TNT criticism:

“(Charles) Barkley should stop before I take his job. Because I can do that well, too... He also can’t talk basketball with me either. Not smart enough, not qualified. No rings, can’t sit at this table.”

Draymond Green on Charles Barkley, Mar 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Charles Barkley
item.description:
Gary Washburn:Joel Embiid on Charles Barkley’s comments:

“I think they’re right. I gotta make a change. I need to be more aggressive, dominate.”

Joel Embiid on Charles Barkley, Dec 12, 2019. Source: Twitter @GwashburnGlobe.

item.title: Hassan Whiteside on Charles Barkley
item.description:
Whiteside didn’t say whether or not he had heard about the comments before the start of the third quarter, even though watching the game it looked that way, but he did have something to say in regards to the halftime comments.

“I expect Shaq to diss, I mean, Dame killed him in a rap battle. We ain’t gonna hear anything positive from Shaq ever again. And Charles Barkely will pretty much go along with,”

Hassan Whiteside on Charles Barkley, Nov 8, 2019. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Charles Barkley
item.description:
Nikola Jokic on Charles Barkley’s MVP comments:

“Thank you.... I really appreciate that. He’s such a big legend telling a lot of stuff about me, nice stuff about me, probably that I’m good. I don’t know why Shaq doesn’t love me... I’m joking. I love you Shaq.”

Nikola Jokic on Charles Barkley, Dec 21, 2018. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.
